board.title: Paradoxes and punctums, threaded
board.note: The 28 readings hung on cords in front of the cork, each theme at its own depth, tied by the threads the texts hold between them: thick dark red where two or three readers found a thread on their own. Tie, cut and relabel threads, and move the stickers in depth, at /stickers.

threads.why: Portals keeps 'the gap at every finite n' positive until a float rounds it away ('Floats do, by forgetting'), while Gödel's pulse 'finds the gap again on every level' and adding the sentence 'does not close it'.

In Ignorance a hole 'is no longer drawn; the cordon stayed', a marker 'standing where the thing was'; in Boolean Verbs the cut sphere 'disappears from view while its contour remains in the other body'.

Black is what is hard to find in both: the black point 'makes a rather poor marker in this light, but I know where to look', and in the colour cube 'even the black corner has been brightened slightly so that you can find it'.

It is one object: Playground says 'You have met it before in Form Finding, where a chosen number of steps helped produce its shape', and both halls say its glass shows an inside it will not open, 'Transparency offers a view, not an entrance' and 'transparency has not made it passable'.

'Nobody drew the amphora' because 'Somebody chose' its stiffness and steps, and ML's mean is 'a movement nobody quite made', made by 'a calculation' and a seed where the recording had an occasion: 'you moved'.

Both are surfaces you see through: the glass skin stops you because 'transparency has not made it passable', while Florensky's leaves are 'faint enough to see the room through them' and 'The closed leaf lets you pass'.

In CA a green cell is still occupied but no longer counted ('Being present and being counted have parted company'), and in PG the ring has appeared but 'the estimator has no case for one', so 'The number has not moved'.

Point Zero's number 'has moved on' before it can be read ('My first number was not its first number'), and Synthesis names that counter outright, 'a counter was already running before we could read it', ending 'The clock is still running.'

Point Zero's frame count 'has moved on' as soon as the newcomer looks away, while PG's score 'has not moved' though 'a conspicuous part has appeared': one number outruns the body, the other overlooks it.

Melencolia's universe is 'closed under everything you can do in it', so a compass draws any circle yet 'cannot draw its way out of the plane'; Gödel's new axiom 'may enlarge what is provable', yet adding the sentence moves the gap up and 'does not close it'.

Color Nails sends the choice onward ('Your hands carry it into the halls ahead'; 'The hand making the next choice is already wearing the last one'), and at the end 'The hand has arrived', having 'crossed the threshold without making the journey', and 'Your hand is missing'.

Change Choreography's pile-up is 'an unwanted result of working parts' ('Everything worked, and this happened'), and GT Matching's first choice 'was allowed' while one person waits and a saw lies unused: 'A rule can be followed while its promise remains unmet.'

Wave Functions says 'The place is the same. The state is not.' of a cube passing one height in two directions, and the CA bridge's gold frame 'holds its place' while the tile gives way, so 'you are still looking at the same address from a little lower down'.

Random Game's REPLAY must 'restore support too', yet 'Your knowledge survives the reset'; Soft Body says 'Restore the settings while the cube is moving' and 'The numbers return sooner than the body', so 'more must be restored than the control panel admits'.

The generated path is 'a movement nobody quite made' although its recording's occasion was 'you moved', and the amber figure keeps 'the hand' while 'Your hand is missing' (the hall opens with 'Look for the hand you moved'): both come from your movement and neither is your movement.

'There was a hole here ... the cordon stayed' and 'I put the black point approximately where the white one was': both are markers left standing where something used to be, cones that outlived the code's hole and a point set down by a hand.

'Returning to a place need not mean returning to the same moment', just as 'a crossing can repeat while the person crossing it cannot return to not knowing': in oscillation and in chance, a repeat that does not give back the earlier state.

A capped heap makes a cube 'disappear ... without a record', and a capped list leaves a mark 'there, then absent' with 'No fading' to give 'it a farewell': two stores that drop what they held and keep no trace of the loss.

The Cantor hall says its question 'begins with a bar, a gap' and will be asked again by 'the foundations-crisis halls'; there Gödel's tower stacks one platform per system and the pulse 'finds the gap again on every level', as Cantor stacks its cut rows in 'levels overhead'.

Portals says no approach 'acquires a last step merely because its display has ended' and 'a limit is not a place'; Cantor's screen 'stops at five' while the construction goes on 'without a last cut' toward a limit 'We have not displayed'.
Cantor's GHOST marks let 'the display remember an absence without filling it', and Boolean's subtraction leaves the sphere's contour in the box: 'Absence has been given a surface.'

Restoring the settings brings 'the numbers' back while the cube 'continues from where it has arrived', and the kept pose brings its coordinates back while 'The hand has arrived. Your hand is missing': in both the record returns and the body's own path does not.
Point_Coordinates is 'watching one' ball, 'looking for a mark the ball could keep', and then 'It is gone'; WaveFunctions_Pendulum: 'Wait with one mark. It is there, then absent.'
A ring is added to the body and 'the number has not moved'; the settings are restored and 'the numbers return sooner than the body': in both the readout and the body part ways.

WaveFunctions_Intro's cube 'passes the place where we first saw it', so 'The place is the same. The state is not.'; Soft_Body_Deformation's cube, its settings restored, 'continues from where it has arrived'.

PG_Genetic_Evolution: 'Look through its opening', and inhabiting would need 'an opening, a surface, a particular body attempting passage'; Playground_of_Joy: 'Look for a mouth', since deforming the sphere 'has not cut an opening'.
On the bridge 'the surface gives way' and 'you are still looking at the same address from a little lower down'; at the glass vessel 'its surface can meet your body' and is not 'passable'.

Melencolia's 'compass can draw any circle' among tools whose 'next use is not settled'; GT_Matching's drill is taken while 'there is still a saw on the table', 'the unused possibility… there all along'.

Ignorance's hole is still 'in the code' though 'no longer drawn'; the sad metal's tears are in its shader but 'read from a texture that this hall never hands it', so 'what you see is the alloy without its tears'.

L-systems' unchanged letters take 'another route through space' and 'The outline alone cannot tell us how many movements made it'; ML, after 'an average route through time', draws 'a movement nobody quite made' whose 'paths may look similar, while their histories differ'.

Point One cannot find 'the click I remember' and presses 'my thumb against the side of my finger, once, to see if that was it'; Synthesis's record 'did not need to remember how your hand found them' and keeps the destination, but 'you may still feel the movement that is absent from it'.
